knownProblems.title: Embalmed Eats couldn't read its settings file and used the defaults
knownProblems.explain: Usually a missing comma or quote. Embalmed Eats keeps a copy of the unreadable file in ModData/embalmedeats/backups before writing the defaults back.
knownProblems.advice: Embalmed Eats' card on the check-up says where the copy is.

knownProblems.title: A preserving method of Embalmed Eats has no recipes: none of its wax or resin items are in the game
knownProblems.explain: WaxItems or LacquerItems in ModConfig/embalmedeats.json names items that aren't in the game (a typo, or a mod that isn't installed).
knownProblems.advice: Embalmed Eats' card on the check-up has a button that puts the default back.

knownProblems.title: Embalmed Eats couldn't change part of the game
knownProblems.explain: Usually the game is newer than this version of Embalmed Eats, or another mod changed the same part of the game.
knownProblems.advice: Embalmed Eats' card on the check-up says which part of the mod is affected.

knownProblems.title: Embalmed Eats couldn't change part of the game
knownProblems.explain: Usually the game is newer than this version of Embalmed Eats, or another mod changed the same part of the game.
knownProblems.advice: Embalmed Eats' card on the check-up says which part of the mod is affected.

knownProblems.title: Embalmed Eats couldn't finish setting itself up
knownProblems.explain: One of its start-up steps (the wax and resin recipes, ground storage, or the creative tabs) failed, so that part is missing this session.
knownProblems.advice: The error under this line says why. A bug report helps: /doctor bugreport embalmedeats

knownProblems.title: Your game couldn't read the server's Embalmed Eats settings
knownProblems.explain: Your game then uses its own settings, so what can be preserved may look different from what the server does.
knownProblems.advice: Use the same version of Embalmed Eats as the server.

knownProblems.match: [Embalmed Eats] Could not send config to
knownProblems.title: Embalmed Eats couldn't send its settings to a player
knownProblems.explain: That player's game uses its own settings until they join again.

knownProblems.title: A food couldn't be put in Embalmed Eats' creative tabs
knownProblems.explain: Only the creative tabs are affected: that food can still be preserved the normal way.

knownProblems.title: Embalmed Eats' part of this page failed
knownProblems.explain: A bug in Embalmed Eats' checks for Vintage Doctor. The rest of the page isn't affected.
knownProblems.advice: A bug report helps: /doctor bugreport embalmedeats
